# `kevin plugin`

Works with the plugins that ship inside `kevin`, and with the plugin
package format used by `plugins:` entries in `kevin.cue` (see
[Configuring an environment]({{< relref "/docs/environment-file" >}})).

## `kevin plugin pack <dir>`

Builds a plugin package (a gzip-compressed tar) from `dir`: a
`manifest.json` plus the entrypoint binary and any files it needs
alongside it. `dir` may already hold a `manifest.json`; the override flags
below fill in or replace its fields, and must fully supply the manifest
when `dir` has none.

```sh
kevin plugin pack ./my-plugin -o my-plugin.tar.gz
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|:-----|:----:|:-------:|:------------|
| `--args` | `stringSlice` | `[]` | default arguments for the entrypoint (overrides manifest.json) |
| `--author` | `string` | - | plugin author (overrides manifest.json) |
| `--description` | `string` | - | plugin description (overrides manifest.json) |
| `--entrypoint` | `string` | - | entrypoint path, relative to dir (overrides manifest.json) |
| `--name` | `string` | - | plugin name (overrides manifest.json) |
| `--output`, `-o` | `string` | - | **Required.** output tar.gz path |
| `--version` | `string` | - | plugin version (overrides manifest.json) |

## `kevin plugin push <tar.gz> <oci-ref>`

Uploads the plugin package at `tar.gz` to `oci-ref` (e.g.
`ghcr.io/acme/plugin:v1`), reusing whatever credentials `docker login`
already wrote. If `tar.gz.minisig` (`minisign -Sm tar.gz`'s default output)
or `tar.gz.sigstore.json` (`cosign sign-blob --bundle`'s output) exists,
push uploads whichever it finds too, for consumers with a matching
`signing:` scheme and the signer trusted (see `kevin plugin trust` below).
The OCI fallback tag holds one signature per digest, so pushing both
schemes for the same package leaves only the one pushed last.

```sh
kevin plugin push my-plugin.tar.gz ghcr.io/acme/plugin:v1
```

## `kevin plugin trust`

Manages the local trust stores a `plugins.<name>` entry's signing block
verifies against: `~/.kevin/trusted-keys` for `signing: scheme:
"minisign"`, and `~/.kevin/trusted-identities` for `signing: scheme:
"sigstore"`. See [the CA and trust guide]({{< relref "/docs/guides/ca-and-trust" >}})
for the machine trust store this is not - `kevin plugin trust` is a
separate, per-key/per-identity store used only for plugin package
signatures.

### `kevin plugin trust add <pubkey-file>`

Adds a minisign public key to the trust store.

### `kevin plugin trust list`

Lists the trust store's keys and identities, scheme-tagged.

### `kevin plugin trust remove <key-id>`

Removes a key from the trust store.

### `kevin plugin trust add-identity`

Trusts a sigstore signing identity - the certificate identity (an email,
or a GitHub Actions workflow-ref URI) and OIDC issuer URL a
`signing: scheme: "sigstore"` package's bundle must carry.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|:-----|:----:|:-------:|:------------|
| `--identity` | `string` | - | **Required.** the trusted certificate identity (e.g. an email, or a GitHub Actions workflow-ref URI) |
| `--issuer` | `string` | - | **Required.** the trusted OIDC issuer URL (e.g. https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com) |

### `kevin plugin trust remove-identity <identity> <issuer>`

Removes a sigstore signing identity from the trust store.

## `kevin plugin index`

Manages git repos that publish discoverable plugins: each repo holds a
`plugins/<name>/{plugin.yaml,versions/<semver>.yaml}` tree. See
[the plugin discovery guide]({{< relref "/docs/guides/plugin-discovery" >}})
for the repo format, the "latest" resolution rule, and the
`<alias>/<name>` disambiguation syntax. This is a phonebook, not a trust
boundary - `kevin plugin trust` above is still required before kevin ever
fetches a signed package.

### `kevin plugin index add <git-url>`

Configures `git-url` as an index source, clones it immediately, and
reports how many plugins it holds. Adding a URL that is already
configured is a silent no-op that reports the existing source.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|:-----|:----:|:-------:|:------------|
| `--as` | `string` | - | alias for this source (default: derived from the URL) |

### `kevin plugin index list`

Lists configured index sources: alias and URL.

### `kevin plugin index remove <alias>`

Removes a configured index source and its cloned repo cache.

### `kevin plugin index update`

Re-clones every configured index source from scratch, independently - one
source's clone or load failure is reported on its own line and never
blocks another source from updating. Exits non-zero if any source failed,
even though every source is still attempted.

### `kevin plugin index show <name-or-alias/name>`

Prints a plugin's metadata, every known version (newest first), and the
latest version's pasteable `plugins: <name>: {...}` snippet, ready to
paste into `kevin.cue`. A bare `<name>` found in more than one configured
source errors, naming every matching alias; retype it as
`<alias>/<name>`.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|:-----|:----:|:-------:|:------------|
| `--version` | `string` | - | show this exact version's snippet instead of the plugin's metadata and version list |

### `kevin plugin index install <name-or-alias/name>`

Resolves a plugin (the latest version, or `--version`'s exact match),
trusts every signer `plugin.yaml` declares for that version's signing
scheme (`kevin plugin trust add`/`add-identity`'s own stores - `install`
is a convenience on top of them, not a new trust boundary: it only ever
trusts a signer the plugin's own identity file names, the same signer a
user would otherwise copy in by hand), and writes the plugin's
`plugins:` entry straight into the environment file - no copy/paste. A
version signed with no matching declared signer prints a warning and
still installs; the entry is safe to write either way. Refuses if the
environment file already declares that plugin name, or isn't a
single-file CUE environment (a YAML/JSON file, or a CUE file using
`package` mode) - either way, paste the printed snippet in by hand
instead.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|:-----|:----:|:-------:|:------------|
| `--no-trust` | `bool` | `false` | skip adding the signer to the local trust store |
| `--version` | `string` | - | install this exact version instead of the latest |

## `kevin plugin search [query]`

Searches every configured index source's plugins by name and summary,
case-insensitively. With no query, lists every plugin found. Each row is
`<alias>/<name>`, its summary, and its latest version.
